exec: pm.test("Documented typed public contracts",()=>{for(const tool of body.result.tools){pm.expect(tool.title,tool.name).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty;pm.expect(tool._meta.fastmcp.tags,tool.name).to.include("public");pm.expect(tool.inputSchema.additionalProperties,tool.name).to.equal(false);for(const field of Object.values(tool.inputSchema.properties)){pm.expect(field.description,tool.name).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty;}pm.expect(tool.outputSchema.type,tool.name).to.equal("object");}});

pm.test("Tool versions match upstream routes",()=>{for(const tool of body.result.tools){const meta=tool._meta.fastmcp;pm.expect(meta.version,tool.name).to.equal(pm.variables.get("momentumApiVersion"));pm.expect(meta.versions,tool.name).to.eql([pm.variables.get("momentumApiVersion")]);}});

pm.test("Upstream API metadata",()=>{const routes={momentum_list_analyses:["GET","/v1/analyses"],momentum_latest_analyses:["GET","/v1/analyses/latest"],momentum_get_analysis:["GET","/v1/analyses/{analysis_id}"],momentum_get_recommendations:["GET","/v1/recommendations"],momentum_suggest_ticker:["POST","/v1/suggestions"],momentum_get_suggestion_status:["GET","/v1/suggestions/{suggestion_id}"]};for(const tool of body.result.tools){const [method,path]=routes[tool.name];pm.expect(tool._meta.upstream,tool.name).to.eql({api:"momentum",method,path});pm.expect(tool._meta.fastmcp.tags,tool.name).to.include("momentum");pm.expect(tool._meta).not.to.have.property("version");}});
